item.text:
Added F5; the audit now has five confirmed, reproducible findings, documented in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md).

| Severity | Finding |
|---|---|
| High | Snapshot install persists the log purge before the state-machine install completes; a crash leaves an unrecoverable state and restart panics. |
| Medium | Documented-valid `PartialSuccess(None)` panics the leader in debug builds. |
| Low/Medium | `purge_batch_size = 0` underflows at `calc_purge_upto()`'s `purge_end - 1`. |
| Medium | `snapshot_max_chunk_size = 0` makes `Chunked::send_snapshot()` send zero-byte chunks forever. |
| Low/Medium | Blocking `add_learner()` returns `Ok` after a leadership change while the learner is still not caught up. |

The new F5 test is [t11_add_learner_blocking_leader_change.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/tests/tests/audit/t11_add_learner_blocking_leader_change.rs). Learner 2's network is blocked, `add_learner(2, (), true)` waits, and node 1 is forced to become leader. The call returns `Ok` while learner 2's matching is absent and the cluster log index is 4:

```
add_learner returned Ok after leadership change; learner-2 matching=Some(None), cluster log_index=4
```

`check_replication_upto_date()` returns `Ok(None)` when the leader changes or the learner is removed, and `add_learner()` treats every `Ok` as a successful “learner is ready” wait. The report includes the contract basis, necessary conditions, alternatives, and remediation.

Verification: the full `tests` package passes with all three audit integration tests; the openraft library suite passes 193 tests. Sources, patches, and targeted logs are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit). Unresolved source-based follow-ups remain recorded: `QuitLeader` does not clear the `replications` map, and zero-valued `heartbeat_interval`/`install_snapshot_timeout` configs were not investigated.
